senses.gloss: to give your opinion, to think
senses.example: ¿Tú qué opinas de la nueva profesora?
senses.exampleGloss: What do you think of the new teacher?

alternatives.reason: Broader and more common; opinar is specifically giving a view.
Used as ¿qué te parece? for a reaction rather than a reasoned opinion.

notes: opinar de / sobre algo; opinar que + indicative. Neutral in Peninsular Spanish.
